description: This file provides utility functions for integrating Google Analytics (GA4) into a web application. It includes functions to initialize analytics, track page views, and track custom events, with environment-based enabling and safety checks for non-browser environments.

methods.name: isAnalyticsEnabled
methods.description: Determines if analytics should be enabled based on environment variables.

methods.name: initAnalytics
methods.description: Initializes Google Analytics if enabled and not already initialized, injecting the gtag script and configuring it.

methods.name: trackPageview
methods.description: Tracks a page view event with the specified path if analytics is enabled.

methods.name: trackEvent
methods.description: Tracks a custom event with specified action and parameters if analytics is enabled.
